info.title: Litara API (T004 additions)
info.description: Library management additions under /api/v1. Shares components with contracts/t003/openapi.json.

post.summary: Plan an in-file metadata write (only for formats with recorded fidelity evidence)
Create a library with its ingestion configuration

get.summary: Read library configuration and root health

post.summary: Plan a copy-only import for review (nothing is copied)

get.summary: Read an import plan and item progress

post.summary: Approve the plan (pending items become imports)
Queue the copy of an approved plan (safe to repeat)

put.summary: Import or skip one item (for example keep a duplicate)

get.summary: Recent scans and their root health

post.summary: Request a scan (or a verification pass)

get.summary: Effective metadata with provenance and suppressed conflicts

delete.summary: Remove a protected edit so other sources apply again

put.summary: Set a protected edit or a protected clear

post.summary: Plan a Litara JSON sidecar export for review

get.summary: Read a write-back plan and its journal stage

post.summary: Run an approved write (staged, validated, journaled)

get.summary: In-file writer enablement per format (all off until fidelity evidence exists)

sourcePath.description: Absolute directory on the server; read-only and never modified.

changes.description: Fields to write: title, authors, series_name, series_index, narrators.

sentinelPath.description: Operator-supplied root identity file, relative to the root; never created automatically.

value.description: Absent when the field was deliberately cleared.

verify.description: Also re-hash every file to detect changed bytes with unchanged size and time.

suffixed.description: The target name was changed to avoid overwriting an existing file.
